head: ed90418122b348c6f7bac8a44eaa62c7ce497f84 (origin/intent/405f7a85-worlds-fast)
mac: Apple M1 (8 GB); Chromium 153 on Metal and Playwright's WebKit 26.6, WebGPU in both; each load alone (the load average under 3 before each); a fresh persistent profile for the first visit, the same for the second; the hour pinned at noon (window.__interiorHour) so the looks compare; the head's build served by vite preview, /api through the read-only proxy (the token to play.maia.city only)

how.shown: the loading card (div.loading[role=status]) gone, looked at every 2 s
how.hold: a 20 ms heartbeat in the page: every gap over 200 ms, with whether the card was on before it
how.grown: __assets.stats(): building and keeping 0 in every renderer three looks in a row, at most 300 s
how.views: Sandbox 1 the census near, mid, far (census/run.ts VIEWS); Sandbox 5 where it opens, then near and far; each after it is quiet again (at most 30 s)
how.frame: the meter (meter.js) over 20 s standing at near once grown

verdict: The head shows both worlds 3-10x sooner on every first and second visit (Chromium 28 s / 16 s and 38 s / 11 s against production's 169 / 31 and 149 / 157; WebKit 60 / 20 and 60 / 21 against 200 / 169 and 118 / 115), and no page is ever blank. But: (1) its frames once grown are worse at the same draws and triangles (Chromium Sandbox 1 61 ms against 42, Sandbox 5 68.5 against 37, GPU time about doubled; WebKit 304 against 81 and 187 against 102.5, CPU and GPU both up); (2) it holds the page longer: WebKit's first visit 38 s and 40 s with the card on, Chromium Sandbox 1's second visit 17 s right after the world shows; (3) the far forest looks different (Sandbox 1's palms and bananas gone from the far ring); (4) in WebKit the ground from the device's cache is broken (Sandbox 5 red, streaked soil; Sandbox 1 black ground patches as it opens). Not the same look; not shippable as it is by these measures.
notes: the head never went quiet within 300 s in three of four first visits (Sandbox 1 Chromium building 1; Sandbox 5 Chromium keeping 14; Sandbox 1 WebKit building 61), so part of its frame cost may be its own building and keeping while measured
WebKit's storage was not cleared with its profile folder: the head's Sandbox 5 'first visit' in WebKit read 48 kept levels (boxed 0)
production's Sandbox 1 second visit in Chromium showed at 31 s (the browser's HTTP cache); its Sandbox 5 second visit did not speed up
Chromium's head Sandbox 1 second visit has no 'shown' shot: the screenshot timed out inside its 17 s hold
